acid_rate_scaling.source: Palandri and Kharaka 2004, kaolinite acid mechanism

approximations: Activity coefficients are fixed at unity; numerical activities are dilute-solution molality proxies.
Total dissolved Al is represented by Al3+; hydrolyzed and polynuclear Al species are excluded.
Total dissolved Si is represented by neutral H4SiO4(aq); deprotonated silicate and polymerized silica are excluded at pH 3-5.
The P&K H+ order is applied to terminal cation-release barriers as a bounded survey surrogate; it is not a proton-explicit elementary mechanism.
The open-flow boundary holds inflow activities constant and removes released products; released lattice cations do not change the reservoir activities.
The 1e-6 product activity is a declared trace-inflow sensitivity condition, not a solubility or equilibrium calculation.

origin_accounting.reservoir_desorption: gross release only; never physical dissolution

product_activity_basis: Declared 1 micromolal trace-product inflow ceiling for a continuously refreshed far-from-equilibrium reactor; a modeling boundary, not a measured universal kaolinite solution composition.
